title: 15m SMT divergence: BTC sweeps its 12-hour low while the alt holds, buy the alt's 4-bar structure break
ex_ante_rule: Chart 15m, UTC, closed bars only; a signal at the close of bar t fills at the open of t+1. Spot, long only, one position per pair, whole balance, same numbers on all pairs, no other filters. Reference B = BTC/USDT for every traded pair X except BTC/USDT, whose B = ETH/USDT; B is an informative 15m pair on the same timestamp; if any B value needed at bar t is NaN, bar t gives no setup and no entry. For a series S: PL_S(t) = min low over bars t-52..t-5 (48 bars, the last 4 excluded); SL4_S(t) = min low over bars t-3..t. SETUP at bar s when both hold: SL4_B(s) < 0.998*PL_B(s) (B sweeps its 12-hour low) AND SL4_X(s) >= PL_X(s) (X makes no new 12-hour low). A setup at s is armed on bars s..s+8. One entry per setup: an entry signal at bar t consumes every setup at bars <= t; bar t is armed if an unconsumed setup lies in bars t-8..t. ENTRY signal at the close of an armed bar t when all hold: (1) close_X(t) > max high of X over bars t-4..t-1; (2) close_B(t) > close_B(t-1); (3) stop check: LL = min low of X over bars t-12..t, d = (close_X(t)-LL)/close_X(t); if d < 0.008 then d = 0.008; if d > 0.03 no signal on this bar (setup not consumed). Consumption follows the signal column, whether or not the order fills. FILL: buy at the open of t+1 (price E) only if flat and fewer than 2 trades on X were opened in the UTC day of the fill (confirm_trade_entry); else skipped. d is stored at the signal and frozen. STOP-LOSS: fixed d below the entry price, E*(1-d), intrabar, triggers when price touches it (custom_stoploss returning d; native stoploss -0.03 as backstop). TAKE-PROFIT: limit at E*(1+1.5*d) (1.5R), filled at that price when a bar high reaches it (at the open if a bar opens above). If stop and target are touched in one bar, the stop counts. TIME EXIT: fill at the open of bar e, exit signal at the close of bar e+47, sold at the open of e+48 (12 hours). No trailing, no cooldown beyond one entry per setup and 2 per UTC day, single cell, no grid. The scout set stop and target from close_X(t); the lab needs a fixed percentage below entry, so d is applied to E. Warm-up: 100 bars (longest lookback 52 bars before a setup plus 8 armed bars = 60, rounded up; no recursive indicators).
rationale: SMT divergence (Altrady): correlated markets normally confirm each other's extremes. When BTC runs its 12-hour low, the stop-loss orders below it fire and usually drag alts to new lows too. An alt that makes no new 12-hour low during the sweep shows its sellers are absorbed by limit buyers. When BTC's sweep fails (BTC closes up) and the alt breaks its last-hour structure, the rebound meets less overhead supply. The counterparties are stop-loss sellers forced out at BTC's break and momentum sellers reacting to it. Altrady requires confirmation (a structure break) and a stop at the invalidation point, here the 13-bar low. No extra activity filter is added (formalised as written): the BTC sweep is itself the volatility event, and the 0.8% minimum stop keeps the base cost at most 0.375R. Target 1.2-4.5% gross, stop 0.8-3%, so the average absolute move per trade is about 1% or more, above the 0.45% conservative round trip; break-even win rate about 45-50% after cost. Expected count: 0.2% sweeps of BTC's 12h low happen about daily in active markets and the hold plus break confirmation passes a fraction, so about 80-250 trades per year per pair, at most 2 per UTC day. In a falling market alts usually confirm BTC's low, so the hold condition removes most setups; in a range, failed sweeps are the pattern traded. Every position is flat within 12 hours.
novelty_vs_tried: New family. CrossPairCatchUp (H-031, H-080) buys a laggard after a BTC up-surge, expecting it to catch up; this buys the relatively STRONG pair while BTC is sweeping DOWN, and only after BTC's sweep fails. SessionRangeJudasSweep (H-096) and HourlyFailedBreakdownReclaim (H-038/055/098) trade a sweep and reclaim of the traded pair's OWN level; here the traded pair must NOT sweep: the signal is cross-asset non-confirmation (one market makes a new 12-hour low, the correlated one does not) on a rolling 12-hour window, not session ranges. Entry needs two confirmations (the alt's 4-bar high break and a BTC up-close), and the stop is structural (13-bar low, 0.8-3%) with a 1.5R target, not a range-high target. No tried rule uses SMT divergence.

sources.title: Altrady: What is SMT divergence in trading
